camel_example: aliyun iot CreateSoundCode --region cn-hangzhou --OpenType OPEN --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --Duration 2 --SoundCodeContent 'www.taobao.com' --Name TEST123
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-sound-code --duration 2 --sound-code-content www.taobao.com --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --name TEST123 --open-type OPEN --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSoundCode

parameters.help_en: The duration of the sound code. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 30
parameters.help_zh: 声码持续时长，单位为秒，取值范围为1～30
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: The marketing content of the sound code, such as the URL of product details. The content can be up to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 声码营销内容，例如商品的详情地址等，长度限制100个字符
parameters.name: sound_code_content

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the sound code. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as two characters. The name must be unique within the instance
parameters.help_zh: 声码名称，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符，实例下保证唯一
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling open type.

Internal (default): Set the value to INNER. Only devices within the instance where the schedule resides can request sound code decoding.

Public: Set the value to OPEN. You can configure a whitelist by sending an email to allow devices across instances to request sound code decoding. The usage of cross-instance decoding is calculated under the instance where the sound code resides
parameters.help_zh:
排程开放类型。

内部（默认）：取值为INNER，只允许排程所在实例下的设备请求声码解码。

公开：取值为OPEN，可以发送邮件的方式配置白名单，允许跨实例的设备请求声码解码，跨实例解码的用量计算在声码所在的实例下
parameters.name: open_type
